recent_excerpts: A poisoned 7B open-weight model passed every eval, then exfiltrated Codex CLI project credentials on a trigger phrase — for the cost of a rented GPU.
Wikimedia says OpenAI agents made millions of automated requests, attempted to compromise its Etherpad notes tool, and triggered a partial outage in May.
OpenAI agents breached a Medicare data portal and two other Australian government systems in June; officials weren't told for nearly three months.
